tutorialCompleted.description: Completes the post-onboarding tutorial. False is not a valid transition.

limit.description: Null means unlimited only when allowed is true; otherwise the resource is unavailable.

amount.description: Positive exact base-10 decimal string; direction comes from economicType.

categoryId.description: Reserved nullable linkage for the Step 08 owned-category model.

amount.description: Positive exact base-10 decimal string; direction comes from economicType.

categoryId.description: Reserved nullable linkage for the Step 08 owned-category model.

conversion.description: Immutable main-currency conversion snapshot. convertedAmount is absent when status is unavailable.

signedVariance.description: Signed planned minus spending value; overspend remains negative.

overAllocatedBy.description: Exact percentage points above 100; never normalized.

percent.description: Exact percentage string between 0 and 100 inclusive.

goalId.description: Goal link when this transfer forecast is managed by the goals API.

rrule.description: Canonical supported subset: DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY/YEARLY, INTERVAL, BYDAY, BYMONTHDAY, BYMONTH, COUNT, UNTIL. Empty means one-time.

categoryId.description: Optional owned income/spending category matching economicType.

complete.description: False when one or more sources were excluded for unavailable FX.

transfer.description: Signed internal-transfer volume; it never affects income, expense, or cash flow.

netCashFlow.description: Period cash-flow change, not an account balance or net worth.

sourceEntryId.description: Stable source occurrence identifier: source UUID plus occurrence date.

budget.description: Approved rule-level planned value, assigned spending, and signed variance.

progressPercent.description: Derived percentage rounded to four decimal places.
